expectation: Membrane ring on a subset of cells (helper/regulatory T cells, bright; myeloid dim), clustered in T-cell-rich lymphoid or stromal aggregates and absent from tumour or empty areas; a moderate fraction of cells, overlapping CD3.
observed: A: strong yellow in discrete patches (cores 3, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12), near-absent in others. B/C: sparse, mostly empty. D: bright membrane-like rims around nuclei. E: CD4 follows CD3-dense clusters, with white overlap in E3 and little signal in CD3-negative areas.
why: CD4 forms membrane-outlined cell clusters that vary by region and overlap CD3-rich T-cell aggregates, which is the pattern a working stain should show.
